title: GO:0000018 · Random: score distributions
caption: Distribution of test-set scores for positives and negatives, GO:0000018 random split. The vertical line is the default decision threshold. SVM (RBF) on Conjoint triad: median score 0.46 for positives against -0.82 for negatives; Logistic regression on k-sep. bigram PSSM: median score 0.97 for positives against 0.03 for negatives. Overlap between the two histograms is what limits AUROC, whatever the threshold.
